qrcode.js
  Package:   qrcode-generator 2.0.4 (dist/qrcode.mjs from the npm tarball, unmodified)

Vendored (not installed through npm) so that the app works offline, with no CDN and no
runtime dependencies to install. Used only to draw the QR code to the admin page in the
"Připojení" dialog (public/js/qr.js). To update: replace the file with the new release's
dist/qrcode.mjs, update the version and SHA-256 above and in test/qr.test.js.
